analogy.rationale: Guanylate cyclase stimulants act on soluble guanylate cyclase (GUCY1A3) to raise cGMP; the same pathway is engaged by guanylate cyclase activators and amplified by phosphodiesterase inhibitors, while cGMP-mediated vasodilation overlaps functionally with potassium channel activators. Because these cell lines are not primarily vascular and express little GUCY1A3, the transcriptional response should be weak.
